description: CONSTITUENTS and WEIGHTS of a China Securities Index Co. (CSI) or SSE index by code: every constituent stock with its weight (%), exchange and the file date, the weight total, plus the index's sector weights (CSI level-1 sectors such as Financials 22.6%, Information Technology 19.3%, and level-2 industry groups such as Banks) and its top-10 holdings with their sector. Answers "CSI 300 constituents and weights", "沪深300 成分股 权重", "CSI 300 sector weights", "沪深300 行业权重", "what are the biggest holdings of CSI 500 (000905)", "CSI 1000 constituents 000852". Constituent weights come from the index's daily close-weight publication and are dated by `constituents_as_of`; sector weights and top-10 come from CSI's index page data and carry their own `sector_weights_as_of` (the two can differ by days). Per-constituent sector is published only for the top 10; for the rest use the stock's own profile. Code is case-sensitive upstream: numeric codes as 6 digits (000300, 000905, 000852, 000016), letter-prefixed ones upper-case (H30269). An unknown or unpublished code returns found:false. Source: China Securities Index Co., index constituent weights and sector weights.

limit.description: Max constituents returned, largest weight first, 1-2000 (default: all). constituent_count and weight_total_pct always cover the whole index.
